N2-01.evidence: Real REPAIR Domain commit in child process followed by immediate process exit; new FastAPI process replays one event; Intent=1, committed Ledger=1, config_version=8.

N2-02.evidence: Actual SSE stream disconnect/reconnect; stable event_seq and Last-Event-ID precedence; history replay confirms durable duplicates can be deduplicated.

N2-03.evidence: Synthetic historical committed-Ledger fixture only; reconciler adds one event and leaves Intent/Ledger/config version unchanged.

N2-04.evidence: A Session-only CHAT_READONLY message is persisted and replayed; answer remains NOT_IMPLEMENTED and Run stays QUEUED.

N2-05.evidence: Other tenant/owner cannot read or subscribe to Session Event history/stream; guessed Session returns 404.

OPS-01.evidence: Actual Uvicorn worker process terminated while a model attempt and checkpoint were durable; next process recovers same Run and checkpoint to WAITING_APPROVAL without approval or action write.

OPS-02.evidence: Virtual-clock tests prove active-only deadline and downtime exclusion; worker-level expired budget blocks to INCONCLUSIVE without a model attempt; real restart retains D2 attempt accounting.

WEB-01.evidence: Real HTTP: unauthenticated 401, forged identity headers do not change support-b scope; TestClient covers wrong password and spoofed body fields.

WEB-02.evidence: Real HTTP: support-a, approver-a, support-b use separate cookie jars; cross-tenant Session/Task 404; approver abort 403; pending approver Task read 200.

WEB-03.evidence: Real HTTP: first Task admission 202, replay 200 with same IDs, changed digest 409; Domain transaction counts and rollback are asserted in pytest.

WEB-04.evidence: Injected TaskRun/critical-correction insert failures roll back; retry creates one accepted command and one revision transition.

WEB-05.evidence: Real HTTP missing CSRF=403, wrong Origin=403; pytest covers expiry, logout, and fail-closed reads.

WEB-06.evidence: Concurrent N1-05 claim has one RUNNING owner; CHAT_READONLY remains QUEUED/NOT_IMPLEMENTED and cannot change business Task state.

WEB-07.evidence: Real loopback HTTP service process, actual model/MCP investigation, Task/Run wait for approval, client disconnect/reconnect and persisted event replay.

first_failures.reason: Smoke driver opened web-server.log before creating logs directory; no service/model request started.
Initial real restart was rejected by stale D3 revision-zero expression; corrected to distinguish None from integer zero.
Initial M1 targeted run expected schema version 1 after M1-02 migration to version 2; assertion updated, old log retained.
Windows byte-range lock release after process termination required bounded startup retry.

git.status_at_report_generation: implementation committed; evidence metadata finalization and push follow on main

known_limits: CHAT_READONLY responses are not implemented and remain QUEUED/NOT_IMPLEMENTED; M1-03/M1-04 scope is not claimed.
The initial Task free text is durably stored but current D2 fixed S1 prompt is not claimed to consume it.
Local password registry and SQLite/OS-lock worker are single-machine demonstration boundaries, not production IAM or distributed exactly-once.
N2-03 uses synthetic historical ledger fixture data; it validates event-only reconciliation, not a new business action.
The interrupted MODEL attempt is RESERVED with no response trace; whether the provider completed the request is unknown, so no successful response/token is claimed for it.

real_model_mcp.token_usage_note: Sum of five completed model traces; the RESERVED attempt interrupted by process termination has no provider response/token record and is not counted as a successful response.

expected_historical_d6_failure_trace.note: The suite intentionally asserts the preserved historical first D3 smoke FAIL; pytest itself passes.
